columns.name: Campaign ID
columns.description: The ID of a campaign. If not specified, we will try and match the campaign ID by the campaign name, and if we cannot find the campaign name, we will create a new campaign with the specified name. Leave blank for new campaign creation.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, not in scientific notation, no decimals or commas

columns.name: Campaign Name
columns.description: The name of the campaign. If specified, we will try to find the campaign id using this, and if we cannot find an existing campaign with the name specified, we will create a new campaign.

columns.name: Campaign Status
columns.description: This is the run status of your campaign. If you are editing the status of your ad, make sure your campaign status correlates with your ad status. For example, if an ad status us set to "paused" but the campaign status is set to "running" this can cause errors.

columns.name: Special Ad Categories
columns.description: Campaigns that are based in or target the U.S. and contain an ad or ads related to financial products and services, employment, housing, and/or political must include at least one Special Ad Category.
columns.format: List one or more of the following, separated by comma: none, financial_products_services, employment, housing, issues_elections_politics.
columns.required: Required for all advertisers. Input 'none' if none of the categories apply.

columns.name: Special Ad Category Country
columns.description: Campaigns with the issues_elections_politics Special Ad Category selected must also specify the country that the ad account is authorized to run ads in.

columns.name: Campaign Objective
columns.description: Allows you to specify what to optimize this campaign for. All ads in this campaign must correspond to the selected objective.

columns.name: Campaign Spend Limit
columns.description: Maximum campaign spending limit.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.

columns.name: Campaign Daily Budget
columns.description: With daily budget, you may spend more on some days and less on others, but will maintain an average daily budget.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.

columns.name: Campaign Lifetime Budget
columns.description: With lifetime budget, we'll never spend more than that amount.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.

columns.name: Campaign Bid Strategy
columns.description: Choose bid strategy for this campaign when using auction buying type to suit your specific business goals.

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: A list of tags to tag this campaign with.

columns.name: Campaign Is Using L3 Schedule
columns.description: True if the CampaignGroup is using L3 Schedule.

columns.name: Campaign Start Time
columns.description: The date that you want your campaign group to start. Enter in a value only if you are creating a new campaign group. If you do not specify a start date, we will run your ad immediately until you pause or delete it.

columns.name: Campaign Stop Time
columns.description: The date that you want your campaign group to end. Only enter in a value if you are creating a new campaign group. If you don't specify an end date, we will run your ad continuously until you pause or delete it.

columns.name: Ad Set ID
columns.description: The ID of an ad set. If not specified, we will try and match the ad set ID by the ad set name, and if we cannot find the ad set name, we will create a new ad set with the specified name. Leave blank for new ad set creation
columns.format: Standard numbering format, not in scientific notation, no decimals or commas

columns.name: Ad Set Run Status
columns.description: This is the run status of your ad set. If you are editing the status of your ad, make sure your ad set status correlates with your ad status. For example, if an ad status us set to "paused" but the ad set status is set to "running" this can cause errors. Make sure both statuses correspond.

columns.name: Ad Set Name
columns.description: The name of the ad set. If specified, we will try to find the ad set id using this, and if we cannot find an existing ad set with the name specified, we will create a new ad set.

columns.name: Ad Set Time Start
columns.description: The date that you want your ad set to start. Enter in a value only if you are creating a new ad set. If you do not specify a start date, we will run your ad immediately until you pause or delete it. If you specify a future start date, please do not specify an ad status or ad set run status.

columns.name: Ad Set Time Stop
columns.description: The date that you want your ad set to end. Only enter in a value if you are creating a new ad set. If you don't specify an end date, we will run your ad continuously until you pause or delete it. If you specify a future start date, please do not specify an ad status or ad set run status.

columns.name: Ad Set Daily Budget
columns.description: The daily budget for the ad set, in dollars. This is only used if you are creating a new campaign.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.
columns.required: Required (if on daily budget and not using campaign budget optimization)

columns.name: Ad Set Lifetime Budget
columns.description: The lifetime budget to spend across the finite lifetime of the ad set. Please complete in order when setting up MOO ads.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.
columns.required: Required (if on lifetime budget and not using campaign budget optimization)

columns.name: Link Object ID
columns.description: Please enter in the numeric ID number associated with your Facebook Page or event. To find your Page or event's ID number, please click on the "Edit Page" link and copy and paste the string of numbers at the end of the web URL. This is normally a string of at least 8 digits that can be found in your web address bar.
columns.format: Page ID or Event ID if creative type is filled out
columns.required: Link object ID: Required only if you choose a creative_type of "fan" or "rsvp".

columns.name: Link
columns.description: The link value or destination URL. Be sure to enter this as a complete URL.

columns.name: Application ID
columns.description: ID of the application to advertise for. This can be found on the Facebook developer site at https://developers.facebook.com/. You will need to register your app before you can run any ads for it.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, not in scientific notation, no decimals or commas
columns.required: Required for app install and app engagement ads.

columns.name: Countries
columns.description: Multi-country targeting only works when no state or city is specified. Be sure to enter the 2 letter ISO code for the country.

columns.name: Global Regions
columns.description: A list of world regions to target. Targeting a world region is equivalent to targeting all countries of that region individually.
columns.format: Country group code (ex. europe, north_america, eea)

columns.name: Excluded Global Regions
columns.description: A list of world regions to exclude from targeting. Equivalent to excluding all countries of that region individually.
columns.format: Country group code (ex. europe, north_america, eea)

columns.name: Cities
columns.description: This field is not supported if you choose to target multiple countries. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty. Delimit multiple options with a ";".
columns.format: eg. Palo Alto, CA; New York, NY.

columns.name: Regions
columns.description: Note that this field is not supported if you choose to target multiple countries. Please spell the full name of the region or state. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.
columns.format: Delimit multiple options with a ",". Please only enter valid states or regions for the country specified.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: ZIP Code: the ZIP code of the region(s).
columns.format: Delimit multiple options with a ",". Please only enter valid zip codes for the country specified.

columns.name: Gender
columns.description: Gender-specific targeting. Leave blank to target all.

columns.name: Age Min
columns.description: The minimum age to target. The minimum value for this field is 13. If you do not choose a minimum age, the system will default the minimum age to 13. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: Age Max
columns.description: The maximum age to target. The maximum value for this field is 65. If you do not choose a maximum age, the system will default the maximum age to 65. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: Education Status
columns.description: Enter a list of education statuses to target. Delimit multiple options with a ",". If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: College Start Year
columns.description: Enter in one college year you'd like to target. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: College End Year
columns.description: Enter in one college year you'd like to target. If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: Interested In
columns.description: This field targets the list of genders in which your audience is interested. Delimit multiple options with a ",". If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: Relationship
columns.description: This field targets users with relationship statuses indicated on their profiles within your target audience. Delimit multiple options with a ",". If you wish to target all, please leave this field empty.

columns.name: Connections
columns.description: This field targets users who are already connected with your group, Page, or application. Enter in the ID for the group, Page, or application. To target multiple objects, enter in ID numbers separated by commas.

columns.name: Excluded Connections
columns.description: This field target users who are not already connected with your group, Page, or application. Enter in the ID for the group, Page, or application. To target multiple objects, enter in ID numbers separated with commas.

columns.name: Friends of Connections
columns.description: This field targets the friends of users who are already connected with your group, Page, or application. Enter in the ID for the group, Page, or application. To target multiple objects, enter in ID numbers separated with commas.

columns.name: Locales
columns.description: Languages. Separate multiple languages by comma.

columns.name: Broad Category Clusters
columns.description: This field targets Broad Category clusters. To target Broad Category clusters, you will need find the ID and names by creating a dummy ad in Power Editor with the appropriate cluster(s) and exporting the ad to Excel.

columns.name: Custom Audiences
columns.description: To target custom audiences, you will need find the ID and names by creating a dummy ad in Power Editor with the appropriate audiences and exporting the ad to Excel.
columns.format: [ID]:[Audience Name], separated by commas. For example: 12345:customers, 12346:other audience

columns.name: Excluded Custom Audiences
columns.description: Similar to custom audiences column, except this one specifies audiences that should not see your ad. To target custom audiences, you will need find the ID and names by creating a dummy ad in Power Editor with the appropriate audiences and exporting the ad to Excel.
columns.format: [ID]:[Audience Name], separated by commas. For example: 12345:customers, 12346:other audience

columns.name: Location Cluster IDs
columns.description: Location cluster IDs. Separated by comma.

columns.name: Excluded Location Cluster IDs
columns.description: Excluded location cluster IDs. Separated by comma.

columns.name: Publisher Platforms
columns.description: This determines the publisher platforms where your ad will display. To run your ad on all possible publisher platforms, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger or whatsapp

columns.name: Device Platforms
columns.description: This determines the device platforms (device types) where your ad will display. To run your ad on all possible device platforms, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of mobile or desktop

columns.name: Facebook Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on Facebook where your ad will be displayed. To run your ad in all possible Facebook positions, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of feed, right_hand_column, instant_article, instream_video or group

columns.name: Instagram Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on Instagram where your ad will be displayed. To run your ad in all possible Instagram positions, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of stream or story

columns.name: Messenger Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on Messenger where your ad will be displayed. To run your ad in all possible Messenger positions, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of sponsored_messages or messenger_home

columns.name: Oculus Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on Oculus where your ad will be displayed. To run your ad on Oculus, select the Oculus positions you want to run on.
columns.format: Any combination of vr_apps, twilight_feed or vr_rewarded_video

columns.name: Audience Network Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on Audience Network where your ad will be displayed. To run your ad in all possible Audience Network positions, leave this column blank.
columns.format: Any combination of classic, instream_video or rewarded_video

columns.name: WhatsApp Positions
columns.description: This determines the positions on WhatsApp where your ad or message will be sent. To run your ad in all possible WhatsApp positions, leave this column blank.

columns.name: Optimization Goal
columns.description: The optimization goal is required for all ads.

columns.name: Billing Event
columns.description: The billing event is required for all ads.

columns.name: Bid Amount
columns.description: The bid amount is required for manual bid ads.

columns.name: Ad Set Bid Strategy
columns.description: Each bid strategy is suited to specific business goals and comes with tradeoffs. If you care most about cost efficiency, the lowest cost bid strategy is best, but it may be harder to get stable costs as you spend. However, if you care most about cost stability, the target cost bid strategy is best, but may be less cost-efficient.
columns.required: Required if Advantage campaign budget is disabled.

columns.name: Beneficiary (financial ads in Taiwan)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in Taiwan.

columns.name: Payer (financial ads in Taiwan)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in Taiwan.

columns.name: Advertiser (Taiwan)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from an ad.
columns.required: Required for ad sets that include locations in Taiwan.

columns.name: Payer (Taiwan)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for an ad.
columns.required: Required for ad sets that include locations in Taiwan.

columns.name: Advertiser (financial ads in Australia)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in Australia.

columns.name: Payer (financial ads in Australia)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in Australia.

columns.name: Advertiser (Singapore)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from an ad.
columns.required: Required for ad sets that include locations in Singapore.

columns.name: Payer (Singapore)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for an ad.
columns.required: Required for ad sets that include locations in Singapore.

columns.name: Minimum ROAS
columns.description: Set a minimum ROAS if you're using the highest value bid strategy and want to make sure the results stay above a certain ROAS amount.

columns.name: Ad Set Minimum Spend Limit
columns.description: Provide a minimum target spend limit to control spend on this ad set. We can't guarantee this amount will be spent.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.

columns.name: Ad Set Maximum Spend Limit
columns.description: Provide a maximum spend limit to control spend on this ad set. We won't spend more than this amount.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, decimals up to 2 points, currency symbol not needed.

columns.name: Advertiser (securities ads in India)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in India.

columns.name: Payer (securities ads in India)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for your financial products and services ads.
columns.required: Required for new, edited, or duplicated ad sets about financial products and services, with audiences in India.

columns.name: Beneficiary (selected locations)
columns.description: The person or organization benefiting from an ad.
columns.required: May be required for some ad sets.

columns.name: Payer (selected locations)
columns.description: The person or organization paying for an ad.
columns.required: May be required for some ad sets.

columns.name: Large Geo Areas
columns.description: Large geo areas. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Excluded Large Geo Areas
columns.description: Excluded location large geo areas. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Medium Geo Areas
columns.description: Medium Geo Areas. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Excluded Medium Geo Areas
columns.description: Excluded location medium geo areas. Separated by ";".

columns.description: Excluded location small geo areas. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Metro Areas
columns.description: Metro areas. Separated by ";".

columns.description: Excluded location metro areas. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Subcities
columns.description: Subcities. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Excluded Subcities
columns.description: Excluded location sub-cities. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Neighborhoods
columns.description: Neighborhoods. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Excluded Neighborhoods
columns.description: Excluded location neighborhoods. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Subneighborhoods
columns.description: Subneighborhoods. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Excluded Subneighborhoods
columns.description: Excluded location sub-neighborhoods. Separated by ";".

columns.name: Ad ID
columns.description: The id of an ad. If not specified, we will try and match the ad id by the ad name, and if we cannot find the ad name, we will create a new ad with the specified name. Each ad id will appear in the "ad_id" column in an exported file. Leave blank for new ad creation.
columns.format: Standard numbering format, not in scientific notation, no decimals or commas

columns.name: Ad Status
columns.description: The run status of an ad. If you are editing the status of your ad, make sure your campaign status correlates with your ad status. For example, if an ad status is set to "paused" but the campaign status is set to "running" this can cause errors. Make sure both statuses correspond.

columns.name: Ad Name
columns.description: The name of the ad.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: The title copy for the ad creative.
columns.format: 25 character limit - must adhere to the ad guidelines

columns.name: Body
columns.description: The body copy for the ad creative.
columns.format: 90-character limit for right-hand column ads, or 500-character limit for Feed ads. Must adhere to the ad guidelines.

columns.name: Link Description
columns.description: The link description is additional text used to emphasize why someone might want to visit your website. It only appears for Feed ads.

columns.name: Display Link
columns.description: If you're using a long website address, your display link will show a shorter, friendlier URL in the placements it appears in.

columns.name: Image Hash
columns.description: The unique identifier of the ad's image. The image hash will appear in the exported file only after the image has been uploaded to the account. This value is only available through an exported file.

columns.name: Creative Type
columns.description: Sets the type of ad. Most of the time, this will be "Page post ad", but it can be set to "Standard" if you only want to run a right-hand column ad. When set to "Page post ad", you need to enter your Page ID in the "Link object ID" column.
columns.format: Standard (right-hand column only) or Page post ad

columns.name: Image File Name
columns.description: The thumbnail image filename and file extension (i.e. the path to an image for an ad, relative to the root of the zip file.) Example: "image1.jpg"

columns.name: Creative Optimization
columns.description: If you want to have your individual image and links automatically selected and ordered in your ad multiple images & links ad.
columns.format: Yes if you want this or no if you don't.
